Subject: Privacy onboarding follow-up & evidence request

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for yesterday's walkthrough. MicroCap Bank is starting procurement and we need to collect the documentation required for our legal/privacy teams before the final security review. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following within 5 business days?

- Article 28 DPA wording and the signed DPA template
- Article 30 processing records extract for the MicroCapBank scope
- Current subprocessor inventory (including regions and subprocessors processing EU/UK data)
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and a short summary of KMS/HSM controls used
- DPIA note: we are preparing a DPIA and would like a short operations note describing data flows, retention options, and where caching might persist PII (if any)
- Confirmation of audit rights and a proposed timeline for a remote evidence pull or on-site audit if required

Attachments: none on this email.

We appreciate a clear list of files you can provide and any items that require an NDA/specific export agreement.

Best,
James O'Connor
Head of Vendor Risk
MicroCap Bank

Hi James / Priya — thanks for the clear list and patience. Below is what we can deliver by EOD Friday (2027-04-09) and notes on items that may need additional agreements: 

Deliverables (attached / links):
- Art 28: DPA template + signed DPA (if executed) — attached in evidence packet (MicroCapBank_Evidence_Packet_v1.zip contains the DPA template).
- Art 30: Processing register extract for MicroCap scope (art30-register-extract_202704.csv) — attached.
- Subprocessor inventory: attached CSV (subprocessor_inventory_202704.csv) with region and transfer mechanism columns.
- SOC 2: redacted SOC 2 Type II summary available immediately; the full redacted report (redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf) is available to share under a mutual NDA / secure evidence access agreement.
- DPIA ops note: we have created a short operations summary (included in the Drive link) that outlines the data flow, caching behavior (KV cache lifecycle), retention options per route, and recommended mitigations for PII in prompts.
- KMS/HSM summary: one-paragraph control description included in the packet. Sample anonymized key-usage extract can be provided under agreement.
- Audit rights: Redwood supports remote evidence pulls and scoped onsite audits. For remote pulls we provision a secure evidence bundle; for on-site audits we ask for 30 days' notice and scope definition. Both options require a standard evidence access attestation; on-site audits require a signed Visitor NDA and SOC2 redaction agreement.

I have uploaded the evidence packet and the DPIA ops note to a secure Drive folder here: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/mcbk-evidence/2027/packet (link in related_links). Please let us know if you need an NDA executed first; happy to loop in Legal.

Next steps / timeline:
- Confirm whether MicroCap needs the full SOC2 under NDA (we can initiate NDA and evidence access agreement).
- Confirm whether onshore-only hosting is required (this affects pricing and Dedicated/private options).
- If audit is needed, confirm scope and preferred dates so we can provision the evidence pull.
